Akali.watch: Once marked, the second dash follows even if you run away. If you have been marked, time Ambessa W Repudiation’s shield for the moment the damage lands.
Akali.build: Prioritize magic resistance on your first defensive purchase and get health as well. Akali P Assassin's Mark, Q Five Point Strike, and E Shuriken Flip deal magic damage, so armor does not help against them. Movement speed also helps you leave the area of a telegraphed attack.
Akali.fight: Trade back when Akali emerges from W Twilight Shroud to attack. If you dodge Akali E Shuriken Flip, look for a chance to close in with Ambessa E Lacerate. Immediately after the slow from Ambessa E Lacerate, land the blade edge of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam, then disengage. Use Ambessa W Repudiation just before Akali's attack lands to shield yourself and strengthen its slam damage.
Akali.laning: After pushing the wave, establish vision at the enemy jungle entrance or join a side lane.
Akali.combo: When closing on Akali, dash with Ambessa E Lacerate to land its extra strike, then land the blade edge of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep after an auto attack. Follow with the readied Ambessa Q Sundering Slam and an auto attack, using autos between abilities to consume passive charges and restore resources. If you open with Ambessa R Public Execution, first check that Akali is the farthest enemy champion along its line, then follow with R → E → auto attack → Q Cunning Sweep → Q Sundering Slam.
Akali.escape: A good opening for Ambessa R Public Execution is after you dodge Akali E Shuriken Flip and both Akali W Twilight Shroud and R Perfect Execution are down. Akali has several ways to move, so do not commit deeply just because one is down. Before Akali R Perfect Execution comes back, look to catch her with the suppression and stun from Ambessa R Public Execution.
Akali.phase: Ambessa peaks in the mid game as she builds core items. Later, target an isolated enemy from the flank instead of diving a grouped team alone.
Akali.teamfight: Approach from the flank after your team draws attention, and check whether Akali W Twilight Shroud, E Shuriken Flip, and her other defensive and movement tools are down. If you target Akali with Ambessa R Public Execution, first check who is at the end of its line. Use Ambessa W Repudiation if damage is coming just before you enter, then dash out with Ambessa E Lacerate after securing a kill.

Ahri.watch: If Ahri E Charm hits you, you may take her entire follow-up combo, so stand behind minions to avoid it. Ahri Q Orb of Deception deals true damage on its return; even after dodging the outward cast, move out of its return path.
Ahri.build: Buy an early Executioner's Calling to reduce healing from Ahri P Essence Theft. Prioritize a way to interrupt or cleanse Ahri E Charm, and build magic resistance against her magic damage. Magic resistance does not reduce the true damage from the returning Ahri Q Orb of Deception, so rely on your health pool to withstand it.
Ahri.fight: Engage after dodging Ahri E Charm while Ahri R Spirit Rush is down. Issue a movement command with Ambessa E Lacerate to close in, land the blade edge of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam on the slowed Ahri, then disengage immediately.
Ahri.laning: After pushing the wave, establish vision at the enemy jungle entrance or move to a side lane.
Ahri.combo: For a basic trade, dash with Ambessa E Lacerate to land its extra strike, then follow with auto attack → first hit of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam → readied second hit → auto attack. The first hit must strike an enemy or minion to ready the second; against Ahri, land both at the edge of their hitboxes. If Ahri R Spirit Rush is down and you have a kill opportunity, close in with Ambessa R Public Execution, then use Ambessa E Lacerate → auto attack → Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam.
Ahri.escape: Go in right after Ahri E Charm misses, especially if Ahri R Spirit Rush is also down. The movement speed boost from Ahri W Fox-Fire remains, so use the slow from Ambessa E Lacerate to create an opening to close in.
Ahri.phase: Look actively for opportunities in the mid game as you build core items. Later, if the enemy is grouped, target an isolated enemy from the flank instead of going in alone.
Ahri.teamfight: Enter from the flank after your team draws attention and Ahri E Charm is down. Before using Ambessa R Public Execution, check who the farthest enemy champion along its line is. If you can catch Ahri, follow its suppression and stun with Ambessa E Lacerate and Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam. If damage is coming just before you enter, shield with Ambessa W Repudiation, and plan a route to dash out with Ambessa E Lacerate after the kill.

Akshan.watch: Akshan Q Avengerang gains range each time it hits an enemy, so do not let your guard down behind the minion wave; dodge both its outward and return paths. Akshan E Heroic Swing lets him engage or escape using walls, so watch his swing path after he attaches the hook. If the targeting indicator for Akshan R Comeuppance appears while you are low on health, move behind terrain.
Akshan.build: Build armor first because Akshan's main abilities deal physical damage. Akshan P Dirty Fighting deals both damage types, so armor cannot block all of it. Reducing attack speed also helps cut the damage from his basic attacks.
Akshan.fight: Make Akshan use E Heroic Swing, then dash in with Ambessa E Lacerate. During the brief slow, land the blade edge of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep, use Ambessa Q Sundering Slam, then disengage. Just before Akshan's attack lands, shield with Ambessa W Repudiation and look to land its empowered slam.
Akshan.laning: Use the blade edge of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep to last-hit and harass at the same time, but do not stay only behind the minion wave to avoid Akshan Q Avengerang.
Akshan.combo: When Akshan E Heroic Swing is down, issue a movement command toward him with Ambessa E Lacerate to land the dash and extra strike. Weave in an auto attack, land the blade edge of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep, then follow with Ambessa Q Sundering Slam and an auto attack. If you enter with Ambessa R Public Execution, follow the landing with Ambessa E Lacerate, an auto attack, Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep, and Ambessa Q Sundering Slam.
Akshan.escape: The opening to engage is right after making Akshan use E Heroic Swing. Close the distance with Ambessa E Lacerate or Ambessa R Public Execution and attack before he can escape. Pushing Akshan into open ground without walls can also deny his hook escape.
Akshan.phase: Ambessa peaks in the mid game as she builds core items. Later, target an isolated enemy from the flank instead of diving a grouped team alone.
Akshan.teamfight: After your team draws attention and Akshan E Heroic Swing, his escape tool, is down, enter from the flank with Ambessa R Public Execution. Before casting, check that the farthest enemy champion along its line is your intended target, and plan a route to leave with Ambessa E Lacerate after the kill. If Ambessa kills one of Akshan's allies and is marked as a Scoundrel, avoid facing him alone: if he kills you, the enemies you killed will be revived.

Anivia.watch: Anivia Q Flash Frost can detonate mid-flight and stun you, so do not just sidestep its visible path; use Ambessa P Drakehound's Step to leave the blast radius. If it hits you, or you are inside a fully formed Anivia R Glacial Storm, Anivia E Frostbite deals more damage, so leave the storm immediately. In a narrow passage, Anivia W Crystallize can block your escape.
Anivia.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Anivia Q Flash Frost, E Frostbite, and R Glacial Storm. If healing from Anivia P Rebirth keeps you from securing a kill after your combo, buy an early Executioner's Calling.
Anivia.fight: Engage when Anivia Q Flash Frost is down and Anivia W Crystallize cannot block your escape. Anivia has no dash, so close in and slow her with Ambessa E Lacerate, land the blade edge of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam, then disengage. If you are looking for a kill, wait until Anivia P Rebirth has already triggered.
Anivia.combo: Issue a movement command toward Anivia while using Ambessa E Lacerate to connect the dash and extra strike. Then use an auto attack, land the blade edge of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep, follow with the readied Ambessa Q Sundering Slam, and auto attack again. If Anivia Q Flash Frost is down and you have a kill opportunity, close in with Ambessa R Public Execution, then use Ambessa E Lacerate, an auto attack, and Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam.
Anivia.escape: Anivia has no mobility ability, so go in when the stun from Anivia Q Flash Frost is down and your escape route is not blocked by Anivia W Crystallize. If Anivia Q Flash Frost hits you, do not continue the fight. Use Ambessa P Drakehound's Step to leave Anivia R Glacial Storm and avoid Anivia E Frostbite.
Anivia.phase: Ambessa peaks in the mid game as she builds core items. Later, account for Anivia's terrain control and do not dive a grouped team alone.
Anivia.teamfight: Fight in open space when possible, since Anivia W Crystallize can block narrow passages. After your team draws attention and key crowd control such as Anivia Q Flash Frost is down, enter from the flank with Ambessa R Public Execution. Shield incoming damage just before you enter with Ambessa W Repudiation, and secure a route to dash out with Ambessa E Lacerate after the kill.

Annie.watch: When Annie P Pyromania has a stun ready, stay outside her ability range. Spread out so multiple allies are not hit by Annie R Summon: Tibbers, and do not linger near Tibbers after he is summoned.
Annie.build: Build magic resistance first so you can survive one instance of Annie’s magic damage. Armor does not help against her damage. Also get movement speed to escape the telegraphed area, accounting for the penetration from Annie R Summon: Tibbers.
Annie.fight: Right after Annie P Pyromania's stun is spent, close the gap with Ambessa E Lacerate when Annie steps forward to last-hit. Use Ambessa W Repudiation to absorb damage as Annie is about to cast an ability, attack briefly, then dash out.
Annie.combo: Then hit the first strike of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam with the blade's edge, and finish with the readied second strike and a basic attack. Time Ambessa W Repudiation for Annie's counterattack.
Annie.escape: The moment Annie spends her Annie P Pyromania stun is your opening. It is easier to close the gap if the shield and movement speed from Annie E Molten Shield are also gone. Once in range, hold her with the slow from Ambessa E Lacerate or the suppression and stun from Ambessa R Public Execution.
Annie.phase: Late game, do not dive a grouped enemy team alone. Approach from the flank to target an isolated Annie.
Annie.teamfight: If Annie P Pyromania has a stun ready or Annie is out of sight, avoid standing on top of allies so Annie R Summon: Tibbers cannot stun you together. Once her main crowd control and defensive ability are spent, flank and use Ambessa R Public Execution to reach Annie, then follow through with its suppression and stun. After the kill, dash out with Ambessa E Lacerate so you do not remain near Tibbers.

AurelionSol.watch: Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on maximum health and helps him gain Stardust, so stand behind minions and do not linger in its line of fire. When low on health, stay out of Aurelion Sol E Singularity's execution zone; if caught, move out immediately. Keep some distance from allies in teamfights to avoid Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
AurelionSol.build: Build magic resistance first because Aurelion Sol's main damage is magic damage. Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid relying on a large health increase alone. Also keep enough health to escape Aurelion Sol E Singularity's execution zone. Movement speed helps you leave telegraphed areas.
AurelionSol.fight: Your chance to close in comes right after Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is spent. When Aurelion Sol steps forward to last-hit, dash in with Ambessa E Lacerate to slow him, hit the blade's edge of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam, then disengage. Choose your dash direction so you do not fight while taking Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light for long.
AurelionSol.laning: After pushing the wave, place vision at an entrance to the enemy jungle or join a side lane.
AurelionSol.combo: If Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is spent, dash in with Ambessa E Lacerate, land its follow-up hit, then basic attack. Hit the blade's edge of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep to ready Ambessa Q Sundering Slam, use it, then basic attack. Use movement commands during each cast to choose your dash direction, and command a dash backward when disengaging.
AurelionSol.escape: Engage right after forcing Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight.
AurelionSol.phase: Aurelion Sol grows stronger as he permanently gains Stardust, so limit his early growth. Late game, look for an isolated target on a flank instead of diving a grouped enemy team alone.
AurelionSol.teamfight: If damage comes in just before you engage, absorb it with Ambessa W Repudiation. Plan your escape route with Ambessa E Lacerate before securing the kill.

Azir.watch: Standing in the attack path of soldiers raised by Azir W Arise! exposes you to repeated damage, so go around the soldiers to reach Azir himself. After Azir moves them with Azir Q Conquering Sands, leave their new position. If Azir R Emperor's Divide is available, do not engage through a narrow passage.
Azir.build: Prioritize movement speed to leave Azir's telegraphed attack areas and close the gap. Build magic resistance rather than armor against his damage.
Azir.fight: After Azir moves his soldiers with Azir Q Conquering Sands, circle around while they are stationary and make a short trade. Dash in with Ambessa E Lacerate to slow him, hit the blade's edge of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep, then leave without lingering.
Azir.combo: Use a movement command toward Azir during Ambessa E Lacerate to dash in, then follow the additional hit and slow at the end of the dash with a basic attack. Space yourself to hit the blade's edge of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep, then follow with the readied Ambessa Q Sundering Slam and a basic attack. If Azir can be caught by Ambessa R Public Execution, check which target is farthest along its line. After landing with Ambessa R Public Execution, follow with Ambessa E Lacerate, a basic attack, and both Ambessa Q strikes.
Azir.escape: Right after Azir E Shifting Sands is spent is your opening to engage. If Azir R Emperor's Divide is also spent, the risk of being pushed away is lower. Close in with Ambessa E Lacerate or Ambessa R Public Execution and make a short trade.
Azir.phase: Azir grows stronger as the game goes on, so late game, look for an isolated target on a flank instead of diving a grouped enemy team alone.
Azir.teamfight: After allies draw attention, wait until Azir R Emperor's Divide and his main defenses are spent, then engage from a flank in open space. Before using Ambessa R Public Execution, check which enemy champion is farthest along its line. If you land on Azir, finish quickly with Ambessa E Lacerate and Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep. Absorb incoming damage just before engaging with Ambessa W Repudiation, and plan a route to dash out with Ambessa E Lacerate after the kill.

Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again on its return, and its return damage increases as health gets lower. If it marks you, move off the straight line between you and Aurora; if you are unsure you have enough health, back away before it returns. Leaving Aurora R Between Worlds after its area forms slows you, so decide whether to leave before it forms or fight inside.
Aurora.build: If the healing from Aurora P Spirit Abjuration keeps her alive through your combo, buy Executioner's Calling early. Her main damage is magic damage, so build magic resistance rather than armor. Aurora P Spirit Abjuration deals damage based on maximum health, so be careful about stacking health alone.
Aurora.fight: When Aurora steps forward to last-hit, close in with Ambessa E Lacerate to slow her, hit the blade's edge of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam, then disengage. Bait out one escape ability, check what mobility she still has, then engage again. Using Ambessa W Repudiation just before her attack lets the shield absorb damage and increases its slam damage.
Aurora.laning: You can also hit a minion with the first strike of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam to ready the second strike.
Aurora.combo: Use a movement command toward Aurora during Ambessa E Lacerate to dash and trigger its follow-up hit, then basic attack. Hit the first strike of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam with the blade's edge, then finish with the second strike and a basic attack. If Aurora turns invisible with Aurora W Across the Veil, wait and watch where she will reappear instead of using abilities hastily. Before engaging with Ambessa R Public Execution, confirm that Aurora is the farthest enemy champion along its line. After landing, follow with Ambessa E Lacerate, a basic attack, and Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam.
Aurora.escape: Your opening to re-engage comes when both Aurora W Across the Veil and Aurora E The Weirding are spent. If Aurora used Aurora W Across the Veil to engage but did not participate in a takedown, its cooldown will not reset; look for a chance to catch her then.
Aurora.phase: Ambessa is strong in the mid game as she completes core items. Late game, look for an isolated target on a flank instead of diving a grouped enemy team alone.
Aurora.teamfight: After allies draw attention and Aurora's main mobility and defenses are spent, approach from a flank with Ambessa R Public Execution and suppress a target. Inside Aurora R Between Worlds, Aurora can cross to the opposite side, so do not chase her in a straight line. Plan your escape route with Ambessa E Lacerate before securing the kill. If Aurora has participated in a takedown and can use Aurora W Across the Veil again, do not leave a low-health ally behind.

Cassiopeia.watch: If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast poisons you, move out of range until the poison ends; it increases the damage and healing of Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. You cannot dash with Ambessa P Drakehound's Step inside Cassiopeia W Miasma, so go around the cloud. When you see Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze begin, turn away to avoid the stun.
Cassiopeia.build: If the healing from Cassiopeia E Twin Fang makes her hard to kill with a combo, buy Executioner's Calling early. Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, W Miasma, and E Twin Fang deal magic damage, so build magic resistance.
Cassiopeia.fight: When Cassiopeia steps forward to last-hit, dash in with Ambessa E Lacerate to slow her, land Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam with the blade's tip, then back off. Do not stay close for long while poisoned by Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast; re-enter after the poison ends. Do not dash through Cassiopeia W Miasma.
Cassiopeia.laning: After pushing the wave, get vision at an entrance to the enemy jungle or move toward a side lane.
Cassiopeia.combo: When you have an opening to reach Cassiopeia, start with an Ambessa E Lacerate dash to land its extra hit and slow. Auto-attack, then land Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam with the blade's tip. Use the prepared Q Sundering Slam immediately, then auto-attack once more to consume an Ambessa P Drakehound's Step charge. If you catch her first with Ambessa R Public Execution, follow up after landing with E, an auto-attack, then the first and second Q hits.
Cassiopeia.escape: Right after Cassiopeia uses W Miasma elsewhere is your chance to close the gap with Ambessa P Drakehound's Step. If Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze is still available, be ready to turn away when you see its cast animation. If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast hits you, retreat until the poison ends, then go back in.
Cassiopeia.phase: Late game, Cassiopeia wins teamfights with sustained damage if she is not caught. Do not engage alone from the front as Ambessa; flank and target someone separated from the team.
Cassiopeia.teamfight: Approach from the side while your allies draw the enemy's attention. When Cassiopeia W Miasma is used elsewhere or key crowd control is down, catch Cassiopeia with Ambessa R Public Execution. If damage is about to hit as you enter, use Ambessa W Repudiation for its shield and to empower the slam. Plan your escape route with an Ambessa E Lacerate dash before securing the kill.

Corki.watch: Corki R Missile Barrage also damages units around the first target hit, so do not hide behind minions; move out of range. Reposition to avoid taking the third missile in succession. Corki E Gatling Gun reduces your armor and magic resistance, so do not stand in front of him. Dash sideways with Ambessa P Drakehound's Step.
Corki.build: Build armor first to account for the physical damage from Corki E Gatling Gun and Corki R Missile Barrage. Armor does not stop the magic damage from Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb and Corki W Valkyrie, and resistances do not stop the true damage from Corki P Hextech Munitions, so consider health as well. Prioritize leaving the range of Corki E Gatling Gun before building more resistances.
Corki.fight: Do not force an engage while Corki W Valkyrie is available. Go in when Corki steps up to last-hit or just after he uses Corki W Valkyrie. Close in with the dash and slow from Ambessa E Lacerate, land Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam with the blade's tip, then take a short trade and back off. Use Ambessa W Repudiation for its shield just before Corki's damage lands.
Corki.laning: After pushing the wave, get vision at an entrance to the enemy jungle or move toward a side lane.
Corki.combo: If Corki W Valkyrie is down, dash in with Ambessa E Lacerate and auto-attack after the extra hit at the end of the dash. Land the first hit of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam with the blade's tip to ready the second, use it, then finish with an auto-attack. When entering with Ambessa R Public Execution, follow up after landing with Ambessa E Lacerate, an auto-attack, then Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam.
Corki.escape: The moment after you force Corki to use W Valkyrie is your opening to engage. Close the gap with Ambessa R Public Execution or Ambessa E Lacerate, then direct the Ambessa P Drakehound's Step dash backward to leave after the trade.
Corki.phase: Corki has low base stats for the first five levels, so pressure his farming from the start of that window and use Ambessa’s mid-game strength. Late game, Corki can cast Corki R Missile Barrage from a safe position. Do not dive into a grouped enemy team alone; flank and target someone isolated.
Corki.teamfight: Once your allies draw attention and Corki W Valkyrie and his key defensive tools are down, enter from the side. Ambessa R Public Execution flies to the farthest enemy champion along its line, so confirm that Corki is that target before using it. If damage is incoming just before you enter, absorb it with Ambessa W Repudiation. After catching your target, escape with an Ambessa E Lacerate dash.

Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike travels in an arc and applies a mark, so sidestep it. If it hits, Diana E Lunar Rush may become available again; dash away with Ambessa P Drakehound's Step. Do not close in just after Diana activates W Pale Cascade. Fight after its orbs and shield disappear.
Diana.build: Consider a movement speed purchase first to get out of Diana's telegraphed attack areas. Build magic resistance rather than armor against her main damage.
Diana.fight: Trade when you dodge Diana Q Crescent Strike or Diana E Lunar Rush is down. Catch her with the slow from Ambessa E Lacerate, then space yourself to land Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep and Q Sundering Slam with the blade's tip. Delay the fight while the orbs from Diana W Pale Cascade are circling.
Diana.combo: Use Ambessa E Lacerate with a movement command to close in, then auto-attack after the extra hit at the end of the dash. Land Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep with the blade's tip to ready Q Sundering Slam, then follow with Q Sundering Slam and an auto-attack. As Diana attacks, use Ambessa W Repudiation for its shield and absorb the damage to empower the slam.
Diana.escape: If Diana engages first with E Lunar Rush without using Q Crescent Strike, she has no way back. Slow her with Ambessa E Lacerate or catch her with Ambessa R Public Execution. Right after you force Diana E Lunar Rush is also an opening to engage with Ambessa R Public Execution. If Diana Q Crescent Strike marks you, create distance because her E may become available again.
Diana.phase: Ambessa is strong in the midgame as she completes core items. Late game, target someone isolated from the side instead of entering alone against grouped enemies.
Diana.teamfight: Keep your distance from allies so Diana R Moonfall does not pull several of you together, and ward her flank routes. Once your allies draw attention and Diana has used her key abilities and defensive tools, enter the backline from the flank with Ambessa R Public Execution. After taking down one target, dash out with Ambessa E Lacerate.

Fizz.watch: If the fish from Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, move away from your allies before the shark erupts so they are not knocked back as well. When Fizz uses Q Urchin Strike to enter as the shark hits, absorb the damage with Ambessa W Repudiation, then check whether Fizz E Playful / Trickster is spent.
Fizz.build: Buy a magic resistance item first. Fizz W Seastone Trident, E Playful / Trickster, and R Chum the Waters deal magic damage, so magic resistance is more effective than armor.
Fizz.fight: Counterattack just after Fizz E Playful / Trickster is spent. Close in and slow him with Ambessa E Lacerate, land Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam with the blade's tip, and weave in auto-attacks empowered by Ambessa P Drakehound's Step between abilities.
Fizz.laning: Trade when Fizz misses a last hit with W Seastone Trident and it goes on its full cooldown, or just after he uses E Playful / Trickster. You can also land the first hit of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam on a minion to ready the second hit.
Fizz.combo: When Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down, use Ambessa E Lacerate with a movement command toward Fizz to close in, then auto-attack after the extra hit. Land the first hit of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam with the blade's tip to ready the second, use it, then auto-attack. Use Ambessa W Repudiation for its shield just before Fizz's damage lands.
Fizz.escape: Engage just after Fizz E Playful / Trickster goes on cooldown. Check whether Fizz Q Urchin Strike is down too; that leaves him fewer ways to escape. You can then catch him with Ambessa R Public Execution.
Fizz.phase: Ambessa peaks in the midgame as she completes core items. Late game, target someone isolated from the side instead of entering alone against grouped enemies.
Fizz.teamfight: Stay with your allies to make Fizz use E Playful / Trickster first, then focus him once it is down. After your allies draw attention, catch a target from the side with Ambessa R Public Execution, but first check which enemy champion is farthest along its line. If the fish from Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, move away from your allies before the shark erupts.

Ekko.watch: When you see the indicator for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, leave the marked area. The returning hit of Ekko Q Timewinder hurts more, so move out of its return path. If Ekko's afterimage is visible, Ekko R Chronobreak is ready; do not chase too hard, even when health is low.
Ekko.build: If the healing from Ekko R Chronobreak keeps denying kills, buy Executioner's Calling early. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Ekko's damage.
Ekko.fight: When Ekko steps up to last-hit, dash in with Ambessa E Lacerate and land the blade tip of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep while he is slowed. Use Ambessa W Repudiation to absorb his damage when he attacks, then leave with a passive dash after the trade.
Ekko.laning: After pushing the wave, place vision at an entrance to the enemy jungle or join a side lane.
Ekko.combo: Dash in with Ambessa E Lacerate, land its extra hit, and auto-attack. Then land the blade tip of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep. Recast the available Ambessa Q Sundering Slam and auto-attack, spending passive charges with autos between abilities. If Ekko R Chronobreak has also been used right after Ekko E Phase Dive brings him in, lock him down with Ambessa R Public Execution, then follow with Ambessa E Lacerate, Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep, and Ambessa Q Sundering Slam.
Ekko.escape: Avoid the area of Ekko W Parallel Convergence and commit after Ekko R Chronobreak is used. Right after Ekko E Phase Dive brings him in, his mobility is unavailable, giving you a chance to land Ambessa R Public Execution. If only Ekko E Phase Dive is down, account for his ability to escape with Ekko R Chronobreak.
Ekko.phase: Late game, do not engage a grouped enemy team alone. Look for an isolated target when Ekko W Parallel Convergence and Ekko R Chronobreak are down.
Ekko.teamfight: Enter from the flank after your allies draw the enemy's attention, and leave the area if you see the indicator for Ekko W Parallel Convergence. Right after Ekko E Phase Dive brings him in, look to lock him down with Ambessa R Public Execution, but first check whether he is the farthest enemy champion along its line. Plan an escape route for the dash from Ambessa E Lacerate before securing a kill.

Galio.watch: When you see Galio W Shield of Durand charging, move outside its taunt range instead of committing damage while he takes reduced damage. When Galio E Justice Punch begins with a step backward, dodge the charge. Avoid the spot where the two gusts of Galio Q Winds of War meet. Leave the area immediately when the landing marker for Galio R Hero's Entrance appears.
Galio.build: Build magic resistance first against Galio's main damage. Because Galio Q Winds of War deals damage based on maximum health, avoid stacking health alone. Afterward, build bonus attack damage on Ambessa, whose abilities have many attack damage ratios, to pressure Galio's low armor with physical damage.
Galio.fight: Back away while Galio W Shield of Durand is charging, then trade after its taunt and Galio E Justice Punch are used. Right after the slow from Ambessa E Lacerate, land the blade tip of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep. Use the shield from Ambessa W Repudiation when Galio is about to deal damage.
Galio.laning: When Galio spends mana using abilities to clear the wave, push the lane to give him less room to influence another lane with Galio R Hero's Entrance.
Galio.combo: If Galio W Shield of Durand and Galio E Justice Punch are down, issue a movement command during Ambessa E Lacerate to approach and land its extra hit. Spend a passive charge with an auto-attack, land the blade tip of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep, then follow with the available Ambessa Q Sundering Slam and an auto-attack. Use Ambessa W Repudiation when Galio is about to deal damage, and issue a backward movement command during an ability cast to leave.
Galio.escape: Go in during the window after the taunt from Galio W Shield of Durand and Galio E Justice Punch are used. If only Galio E Justice Punch is down, check whether Galio R Hero's Entrance is still available; in particular, look for a chance to engage with Ambessa R Public Execution before his ultimate comes back up.
Galio.phase: Ambessa peaks in the mid game after building bonus attack damage. Late game, look for a separated target from the flank instead of engaging a grouped enemy team alone.
Galio.teamfight: While Galio R Hero's Entrance is ready, do not start a small skirmish against Galio's team, even in another lane. In teamfights, enter from the flank with Ambessa R Public Execution onto the backline after Galio's main crowd control and defensive abilities are used. If damage comes in just before you engage, absorb it with Ambessa W Repudiation. After securing a kill, dash out with Ambessa E Lacerate along your planned route.

Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can carry her through low-health minions in succession to close the gap and heal, so keep your distance when minions are near death. Watch for the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet. If you are trapped by the barrier from Irelia R Vanguard's Edge, wait until the blades disappear.
Irelia.build: Buy Executioner's Calling early because the healing from Irelia Q Bladesurge can help her survive your combo. The provided information is insufficient to determine which type of resistance to build.
Irelia.fight: Take a short trade when Irelia steps up to last-hit or right after she uses Irelia Q Bladesurge. Close in with the dash and slow from Ambessa E Lacerate, land the blade tips of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep and Ambessa Q Sundering Slam, then leave. Use the shield from Ambessa W Repudiation when Irelia is about to hit you.
Irelia.laning: Do not leave low-health minions between you and Irelia; this reduces her approach routes with Irelia Q Bladesurge.
Irelia.combo: After Irelia uses Irelia Q Bladesurge, dash in with Ambessa E Lacerate and land its extra hit. Weave in an auto-attack, then land the blade tips of both the first hit of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep and its Ambessa Q Sundering Slam recast. Finish with an auto-attack to spend a passive charge, and issue a backward movement command during an ability cast to leave. If the first hit of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep misses completely, Ambessa Q Sundering Slam will not become available, so check your angle for that first hit.
Irelia.escape: Right after you make Irelia use Irelia Q Bladesurge is Ambessa's opening to engage. If the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet is also down, close in with Ambessa R Public Execution to chain its suppression and stun. Plan which way to dash out with Ambessa E Lacerate in case you cannot secure the kill.
Irelia.phase: Ambessa is strongest in the mid game as she builds core items. Late game, do not engage a grouped enemy team alone; look for a separated target from the flank.
Irelia.teamfight: Prioritize Irelia because Irelia R Vanguard's Edge and Irelia E Flawless Duet have a major impact on teamfights. After your allies draw attention and Irelia's main crowd control is used, enter from the flank with Ambessa R Public Execution. On landing, follow with Ambessa E Lacerate, Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep, and Ambessa Q Sundering Slam. If damage comes in just before you engage, absorb it with the shield from Ambessa W Repudiation. Dash out after the fight.

Hwei.watch: If the root or forced movement from Hwei E Subject: Torment hits you, it is hard to avoid the follow-up damage. If one of Hwei's abilities hits you, immediately reposition with Ambessa P Drakehound's Step to avoid the second ability and the mark's explosion.
Hwei.build: Build magic resistance first against Hwei's magic damage. Hwei Q Subject: Disaster deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone. If Hwei E Subject: Torment keeps locking you down, consider Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar.
Hwei.fight: When Hwei steps forward to last-hit or right after he uses Hwei E Subject: Torment, dash in with Ambessa E Lacerate. Land the blade tip of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep and follow with Ambessa Q Sundering Slam, then dash out without lingering.
Hwei.combo: Issue a movement command during Ambessa E Lacerate to close in, land its extra hit, and auto-attack. Then land the blade tip of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep, use Ambessa Q Sundering Slam, and auto-attack. When engaging with Ambessa R Public Execution, first check that Hwei is the farthest enemy champion along its line. After landing, follow with Ambessa E Lacerate, an auto-attack, and both Q hits.
Hwei.escape: Hwei has no mobility ability, so right after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used to poke or clear the wave is an opportunity to engage. If Hwei E Subject: Torment is still available, delay your engage because its root or forced movement can stop you. Ambessa is unstoppable during Ambessa R Public Execution but can be rooted after landing.
Hwei.phase: Actively look for opportunities in the mid game as you build core items. Late game, look for a separated target from the flank instead of engaging a grouped enemy team alone.
Hwei.teamfight: While your allies draw the enemy's attention, watch from the flank for Hwei E Subject: Torment and his main defensive abilities to be used. If damage comes in just before you engage, absorb it with Ambessa W Repudiation. Close in on Hwei with Ambessa R Public Execution and land follow-up attacks between its suppression and stun. Plan an escape route for the dash from Ambessa E Lacerate before securing the kill.

Karma.watch: Taking free poke from Karma Q Inner Flame lets Karma P Gathering Fire reduce the cooldown of Karma R Mantra so it becomes available sooner. If you are hit by the empowered Q's ground area, leave the circle before it detonates again. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects, move away to break the tether before it roots you. Delay your engage while Karma E Inspire's shield and movement speed boost are active.
Karma.build: Build magic resistance first against Karma's main damage. If the healing from Karma W Focused Resolve empowered by Karma R Mantra keeps you from securing kills, buy Executioner's Calling early. If the root keeps stopping your engages, consider Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar.
Karma.fight: Close the gap after Karma W Focused Resolve is down and the shield from Karma E Inspire expires. Dash with Ambessa E Lacerate to slow her, land Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep and Ambessa Q Sundering Slam with the blade's tip, then disengage. If Karma W Focused Resolve empowered by Karma R Mantra connects, dash away to break the tether unless you can kill her quickly.
Karma.laning: Use the tip of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep to last-hit and poke at the same time. Dodge Karma Q Inner Flame by moving behind minions or out of range.
Karma.combo: If Karma W Focused Resolve is down, dash in with Ambessa E Lacerate and land an auto attack after the extra hit at the end of the dash. Then hit with the blade tip of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep, recast it as Ambessa Q Sundering Slam, and auto attack. If Karma is out of range of the first hit of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep, you can hit a minion to ready Ambessa Q Sundering Slam.
Karma.escape: Karma W Focused Resolve being down is your opening to engage. Check that the movement speed boost from Karma E Inspire has ended and its shield has also disappeared. Ambessa R Public Execution is unstoppable during its cast, but you can still be rooted after landing, so do not use it to engage while Karma W Focused Resolve is available.
Karma.phase: Look actively for openings in the mid game as you complete core items. In the late game, avoid diving a grouped team alone and target someone isolated from the flank.
Karma.teamfight: Wait to engage if Karma W Focused Resolve is available or the shield from Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra is active. While your team draws their attention, flank and use Ambessa R Public Execution to reach your target, then chain Ambessa E Lacerate and Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep between the suppression and stun. If damage is coming just before you engage, absorb it with Ambessa W Repudiation. After a kill, use an exit route you can dash along with Ambessa E Lacerate.

Kassadin.watch: The slow from Kassadin E Force Pulse makes chasing and disengaging harder, so approach after he uses it. If Kassadin R Riftwalk is ready, he can escape Ambessa's engage, so track whether he has used it. Kassadin Q Null Sphere grants a shield, but it absorbs magic damage, so you need not pass up a chance to deal Ambessa's main physical damage.
Kassadin.build: The available information does not specify a first item purchase. Build magic resistance against damage from Kassadin Q Null Sphere, Kassadin W Nether Blade, and Kassadin E Force Pulse. Kassadin W Nether Blade restores mana, not health, so there is no reason to prioritize healing reduction.
Kassadin.fight: Right after slowing Kassadin with Ambessa E Lacerate, land Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep with the blade's tip. Follow with Ambessa Q Sundering Slam, then disengage. If Kassadin R Riftwalk is down, you have an opening to catch him with Ambessa R Public Execution.
Kassadin.laning: Using unnecessary abilities near Kassadin lets him cast Kassadin E Force Pulse again sooner. Clear the wave outside its range when possible.
Kassadin.combo: Dash toward Kassadin with Ambessa E Lacerate to land the extra hit, then auto-attack. Land Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep with the blade's tip to prepare Ambessa Q Sundering Slam, then recast it and auto-attack. If Kassadin is out of range of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep, you can hit a minion with its first strike to prepare Ambessa Q Sundering Slam.
Kassadin.escape: Right after Kassadin R Riftwalk is used is your opening to engage. If the slow from Kassadin E Force Pulse is also down, it is a good time to close in with an Ambessa E Lacerate dash. If Kassadin has used Kassadin R Riftwalk repeatedly, check his mana and counterattack when he cannot jump again.
Kassadin.phase: Ambessa is strong in the mid game as she completes core items. In the late game, watch for Kassadin diving your backline and target isolated enemies from the flank.
Kassadin.teamfight: Engage from the flank after your team draws attention and Kassadin R Riftwalk or his main defensive means are down. Ambessa R Public Execution targets the farthest enemy champion along the chosen line, so check who that will be before casting. Use Ambessa W Repudiation for its shield just before burst damage lands, and leave yourself a route to dash out with Ambessa E Lacerate after a kill.

Lux.watch: If Lux Q Light Binding roots you, her other abilities are likely to follow. Bait it out and approach after it misses. You can still be rooted while standing behind an ally, so avoid lining up with them. Dodge sideways when you see the red aiming line for Lux R Final Spark.
Lux.build: If Lux Q Light Binding roots you, you cannot use Ambessa's dashes to control your distance, so consider Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Lux's damage.
Lux.fight: As soon as Lux Q Light Binding misses, dash in with Ambessa E Lacerate. During the brief slow, land Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep with the blade's tip. If that first hit connects, follow with the prepared Ambessa Q Sundering Slam, then disengage.
Lux.laning: Early on, do not force your way through Lux's ranged poke. Use the tip of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep to last-hit and poke while keeping up in levels. Take a short trade when Lux steps forward to last-hit and Lux Q Light Binding is down. After pushing the wave, place vision at an entrance to the enemy jungle or move toward a side lane.
Lux.combo: After dodging Lux Q Light Binding, dash in with Ambessa E Lacerate, land the extra hit, and auto-attack. Then land Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep with the blade's tip and finish with the prepared Ambessa Q Sundering Slam and an auto-attack. Spend passive charges with auto-attacks between abilities so your resources last through the combo.
Lux.escape: Lux has no mobility ability, so the moment Lux Q Light Binding misses is an opening to engage. Avoid the area covered by Lux E Lucent Singularity and close in from the flank. Even if you engage with Ambessa R Public Execution, you can be rooted after landing, so check whether Lux Q Light Binding is still available.
Lux.phase: Create openings actively in the mid game as you complete core items. In the late game, avoid diving a grouped team alone and target an isolated Lux from the flank.
Lux.teamfight: While your team draws attention, flank and check whether Lux Q Light Binding and her defensive abilities are down. Approach from a different direction than your team so Lux E Lucent Singularity cannot block you all in one spot. Use Ambessa R Public Execution to reach Lux, then land Ambessa E Lacerate and Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep between the suppression and stun. If damage is coming just before you engage, absorb it with Ambessa W Repudiation. After the kill, dash out with Ambessa E Lacerate.

Leblanc.watch: While LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice's mark remains, her next ability deals more damage. Back off and let the mark expire. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains hits, use Ambessa P Drakehound's Step to dash out of chain range before the root triggers. When LeBlanc P Mirror Image creates a clone, hold your abilities until you identify which one is actually attacking.
Leblanc.build: LeBlanc's main abilities deal magic damage, so build magic resistance over armor. Prioritize considering a spell-shield item to break a combo that starts with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice. If the root from LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains stops you from engaging, also consider Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar.
Leblanc.fight: LeBlanc can return immediately after engaging with LeBlanc W Distortion, so close in after she uses the return or its window expires. When she steps forward to last-hit, dash in with Ambessa E Lacerate to slow her, land the blade tip of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep, then take a short trade and back off. Use Ambessa W Repudiation's shield just before her burst lands.
Leblanc.laning: Don't force an early engage. Use the blade tip of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep to last-hit and poke at the same time. Save Ambessa E Lacerate for a chance to close on LeBlanc, and don't linger after trading. If LeBlanc disappears from mid, alert your team immediately and check river vision.
Leblanc.combo: After LeBlanc uses the return on LeBlanc W Distortion, dash in with Ambessa E Lacerate and land its extra hit at the end of the dash. Follow with an auto attack, the blade tip of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep, Ambessa Q Sundering Slam, and another auto attack. The first hit of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep must land to enable the second hit.
Leblanc.escape: Engage after LeBlanc uses LeBlanc W Distortion and either uses its return or lets the return window expire. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains hits you, dash out of chain range before the root triggers. Don't rush an engage while the root remains a threat.
Leblanc.phase: Look actively for opportunities in mid game as you build core items. In late game, avoid engaging a grouped enemy team alone and look for an isolated target from the flank.
Leblanc.teamfight: After an ally draws the enemy's attention, check that LeBlanc W Distortion and key crowd control abilities are down. Engage from the flank with Ambessa R Public Execution, checking beforehand which enemy champion is farthest along its targeted line. After landing, follow with Ambessa E Lacerate and Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep. Plan your escape route with an Ambessa E Lacerate dash before securing a kill.

Lissandra.watch: A root from Lissandra W Ring of Frost or a stun from Lissandra R Frozen Tomb leaves you vulnerable to follow-up damage, so check whether she has used both abilities before engaging. If Lissandra casts Lissandra R Frozen Tomb on herself, she becomes immune to damage; space out your damage until it ends.
Lissandra.build: Build magic resistance against Lissandra's main damage. If the healing from Lissandra R Frozen Tomb makes her hard to kill, buy Executioner's Calling early. If the root from Lissandra W Ring of Frost and the stun from Lissandra R Frozen Tomb keep locking you down, consider Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar.
Lissandra.fight: When Lissandra uses Lissandra W Ring of Frost on the wave or misses it, dash in with Ambessa E Lacerate. Right after its slow, land the blade tip of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep, follow with Ambessa Q Sundering Slam, then back off. Lissandra has relatively low armor, so Ambessa's physical damage is effective against her.
Lissandra.laning: Early on, don't force your way in through ranged poke. Use the blade tip of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep to last-hit and poke at the same time. After pushing the wave, establish vision at an enemy jungle entrance or move to a side lane.
Lissandra.combo: Once Lissandra W Ring of Frost is down, issue a movement command with Ambessa E Lacerate to dash in, then auto attack after its extra hit. Land the blade tip of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep, then finish with Ambessa Q Sundering Slam and an auto attack. If you engage with Ambessa R Public Execution, follow the landing with Ambessa E Lacerate, an auto attack, Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep, and Ambessa Q Sundering Slam.
Lissandra.escape: Right after Lissandra recasts Lissandra E Glacial Path to move, she has no escape left, giving you a chance to close the gap or catch her with Ambessa R Public Execution. Check that Lissandra W Ring of Frost is also down before going in to reduce the risk of being rooted after landing. If Lissandra R Frozen Tomb is available, she can use it on herself to avoid damage, so finish her after that state ends.
Lissandra.phase: Ambessa peaks in mid game as she builds core items. In late game, look for an isolated target from the flank instead of engaging a grouped enemy team alone.
Lissandra.teamfight: Engage from the flank after an ally draws the enemy's attention and key crowd control abilities such as Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb have been used. If Lissandra E Glacial Path is also down, look for a chance to catch her with Ambessa R Public Execution. If damage is incoming just before you engage, shield it with Ambessa W Repudiation. Plan your escape route with Ambessa E Lacerate before securing a kill.

Malzahar.watch: When a minion affected by Malzahar E Malefic Visions dies, the effect spreads to a nearby enemy, so move away from that minion. When you see Malzahar Q Call of the Void, step outside the line between its two portals and engage after the silence ends. Ambessa W Repudiation's shield and dashes cannot break the suppression from Malzahar R Nether Grasp, so don't enter an area without vision alone while his ultimate is available.
Malzahar.build: Build magic resistance first against Malzahar Q Call of the Void, Malzahar W Void Swarm, and Malzahar E Malefic Visions. Consider Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar for Malzahar R Nether Grasp. Its damage scales with maximum health, so avoid building only a large amount of health.
Malzahar.fight: If Malzahar P Void Shift is active, remove it first with Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep or another ability before going in. After dodging Malzahar Q Call of the Void, dash in with Ambessa E Lacerate as the voidlings disappear, apply its slow, then land the blade tip of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep. Weave in auto attacks with the extra range from Ambessa P Drakehound's Step between abilities, and use Ambessa W Repudiation to absorb Malzahar's counterattack.
Malzahar.laning: When Malzahar pushes the lane, remove Malzahar P Void Shift and look for a chance to catch him with your jungler. Pressure him early to give him less time to build up Malzahar W Void Swarm.
Malzahar.combo: First remove Malzahar P Void Shift with Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep, then engage when Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep is available again. If you close in with Ambessa R Public Execution, follow with an Ambessa E Lacerate dash, an auto attack, Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep, Ambessa Q Sundering Slam, and another auto attack. Land the blade tip of the first Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep to prepare its second hit, and weave in auto attacks between abilities whenever possible.
Malzahar.escape: Malzahar has no ability to create distance on his own, so dodging Malzahar Q Call of the Void and removing Malzahar P Void Shift creates an opening to engage. If voidlings from Malzahar W Void Swarm are already out, clear them with Ambessa's area abilities before closing in. Don't engage alone while Malzahar R Nether Grasp is available, and plan the direction of your escape dash with Ambessa E Lacerate.
Malzahar.phase: Malzahar grows stronger as he builds up Malzahar W Void Swarm, so pressure him early. In late game, look for an isolated target from the flank instead of engaging a grouped enemy team alone.
Malzahar.teamfight: After an ally draws attention, check that Malzahar Q Call of the Void and key crowd control abilities have been used, then approach from the flank. Remove Malzahar P Void Shift first. If no voidlings are present, engage with Ambessa R Public Execution, checking that the farthest enemy champion along its line is your intended target. Use Ambessa W Repudiation if damage is about to hit just before you engage, then dash out along your planned route with Ambessa E Lacerate after attacking.

Mel.watch: The center of Mel E Solar Snare roots you and makes Mel Q Radiant Volley easy to land, so dodge to the side and save the dash from Ambessa P Drakehound's Step. As stacks of Mel P Searing Brilliance build, you can be executed even with health and shields remaining, so back off if you've been hit by several rounds of poke. While stacks remain, Mel R Golden Eclipse can reach you from far away, so wait somewhere safe even after the fight.
Mel.build: Build magic resistance first against Mel's main damage. If Mel E Solar Snare frequently roots you after you engage, consider Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar.
Mel.fight: Look to close the gap when Mel W Rebuttal and Mel E Solar Snare are down. When Mel steps forward to last-hit, close in with Ambessa E Lacerate. While she is slowed, land the blade tip of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep and Ambessa Q Sundering Slam, then back off immediately. Use Ambessa W Repudiation's shield to absorb her damage when she counterattacks.
Mel.laning: After pushing the wave, establish vision at an enemy jungle entrance or join a side lane.
Mel.combo: If you've dodged Mel E Solar Snare and Mel W Rebuttal is down, issue a movement command with Ambessa E Lacerate to close in. After the extra hit at the end of the dash, follow with an auto attack, the first hit of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep, the prepared second hit with Ambessa Q Sundering Slam, and another auto attack. Land the first hit to prepare the second, and use dashes to adjust your distance so the blade tip of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep connects when you're close.
Mel.escape: Mel has no mobility ability, so the window to engage is after Mel E Solar Snare and Mel W Rebuttal are down. Ambessa is unstoppable during Ambessa R Public Execution, but you can be rooted after landing, so choose your landing position carefully if Mel E Solar Snare is still available.
Mel.phase: Ambessa is strong in mid game as she builds core items, so use that window to take control. Mel R Golden Eclipse's permanent scaling stacks put you at a disadvantage in late game, so don't engage a grouped enemy team alone.
Mel.teamfight: After an ally draws the enemy's attention, check that Mel E Solar Snare and Mel W Rebuttal are down before engaging from the flank. If damage is incoming just before you engage, absorb it with Ambessa W Repudiation. Plan your escape route with an Ambessa E Lacerate dash before securing a kill.

Naafiri.watch: If Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers hits you once, keep your distance until the bleed ends to avoid the second hit. While Naafiri W The Call of the Pack is active, save targeted abilities until it ends.
Naafiri.build: Buy Executioner's Calling early to counter the healing from Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and Naafiri E Eviscerate. Naafiri deals physical damage, so build armor; add health if you also need to survive damage from the pack.
Naafiri.fight: Right after Naafiri uses E Eviscerate, look for a counterattack while clearing the pack with Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep. When Naafiri steps forward to last hit, close in with Ambessa E Lacerate. While she is slowed, land the blade tip of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep, take a short trade, then back off. Use Ambessa W Repudiation just before her attack lands to absorb it with the shield and increase the slam's damage.
Naafiri.laning: After pushing the wave, ward the enemy jungle entrance to prepare for Naafiri's midgame roams.
Naafiri.combo: Give Ambessa E Lacerate a movement command toward the enemy to dash and land the extra hit, then auto attack. Land the blade tip of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep, use the prepared Ambessa Q Sundering Slam, then auto attack again. Weave in Ambessa W Repudiation as Naafiri's attack lands, and give a backward movement command with an ability when disengaging.
Naafiri.escape: Do not engage just because Naafiri E Eviscerate is down. Check whether Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit are available too. The window before Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit comes back is especially good for closing in with Ambessa R Public Execution. If Naafiri W The Call of the Pack is active, wait for it to end before using Ambessa R Public Execution.
Naafiri.phase: Ambessa is strong in the midgame as she completes core items, but Naafiri's roams are also most dangerous then, so maintain broad vision. In the late game, group to stop Naafiri's engage. Ambessa should look for an isolated target from the flank instead of engaging alone from the front.
Naafiri.teamfight: Enter from the flank while your team draws their attention. Before using Ambessa R Public Execution, check which enemy champion is farthest along its line. Once their key crowd control and defensive abilities are down, suppress one target and plan your escape route with Ambessa E Lacerate in advance. Right after an ally dies, Naafiri can use R Hounds' Pursuit again, so retreat together to avoid being picked off one after another.

Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs grows larger and faster after hitting something, so do not stand behind the unit it hits or overlap with an ally. The windup for Neeko R Pop Blossom may be hidden while she is disguised; spread out early if a suspicious target approaches. Do not chase the clone from Neeko W Shapesplitter.
Neeko.build: Build magic resistance first against Neeko's main damage. If getting rooted by Neeko E Tangle-Barbs leads to death from Neeko R Pop Blossom, prioritize tenacity. If the root stops your engage, consider Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar.
Neeko.fight: Right after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is used, close in with Ambessa E Lacerate for a short trade when Neeko steps forward to last hit. Shield Neeko Q Blooming Burst with Ambessa W Repudiation as it comes in, and choose the dash direction of Ambessa P Drakehound's Step with each ability to engage or disengage.
Neeko.laning: You can hit a minion with the first cast of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam to prepare the second. After pushing the wave, ward the enemy jungle entrance or move to a side lane.
Neeko.combo: When Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down, dash in with Ambessa E Lacerate, land the extra hit and slow, then auto attack. Land the blade tip of the first cast of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam, then finish with the second cast and an auto attack. When engaging with Ambessa R Public Execution, check that Neeko is the farthest enemy champion along its line, then follow the same sequence after landing.
Neeko.escape: Right after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is used is your chance to engage with less risk of being rooted. After the trade, aim the dash from Ambessa P Drakehound's Step backward to disengage immediately.
Neeko.phase: Ambessa peaks in the midgame as she completes core items. In the late game, look for an isolated target from the flank instead of engaging alone into grouped enemies.
Neeko.teamfight: If a disguised Neeko approaches, spread out from your allies early because the windup for Neeko R Pop Blossom may be hidden. Once Neeko E Tangle-Barbs and Neeko R Pop Blossom are down and your team draws their attention, use Ambessa R Public Execution from the flank to reach the backline. If damage comes in just before you engage, absorb it with Ambessa W Repudiation. After taking out one target, set an escape route for the dash from Ambessa E Lacerate.

Orianna.watch: Watch where Orianna places her ball with Orianna Q Command: Attack and move accordingly. Avoid the area around it, where Orianna R Command: Shockwave can pull you in. Also watch for the slow from Orianna W Command: Dissonance and consecutive auto attacks from Orianna P Clockwork Windup.
Orianna.build: Build magic resistance first because Orianna's main damage is magic damage. Movement speed also helps you leave areas Orianna has covered.
Orianna.fight: Right after Orianna moves her ball away from herself with Orianna Q Command: Attack is a chance to trade. When she steps forward to last hit, give Ambessa E Lacerate a movement command to close in. While she is slowed, land the blade tip of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam, then back off.
Orianna.laning: After pushing the wave, ward the enemy jungle entrance or join a side lane.
Orianna.combo: Give Ambessa E Lacerate a forward movement command to land the dash and extra hit, then auto attack. Land the blade tip of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep to prepare Ambessa Q Sundering Slam, use it, then auto attack. Auto attack between abilities to spend passive stacks and restore resources.
Orianna.escape: Orianna has no ability to create distance on her own, so it is a good time to engage after Orianna W Command: Dissonance and Orianna R Command: Shockwave are down. In particular, if you close in while her ball is away from her, she also lacks the persistent armor and magic resistance from Orianna E Command: Protect.
Orianna.phase: Ambessa is strong in the midgame as she completes core items. In the late game, look for an isolated target from the flank instead of engaging alone into grouped enemies.
Orianna.teamfight: While your team draws their attention, position on the flank and check Orianna's ball position and whether she has used Orianna R Command: Shockwave. Once her key defenses are down, enter the backline with Ambessa R Public Execution, first checking who the target at the end of its line will be. After landing, follow with Ambessa E Lacerate, an auto attack, and Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam. After the kill, escape with an E dash along your planned route.

Qiyana.watch: Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent pushes enemies toward terrain and stuns them, so do not fight with your back to a wall or in the river or narrow passages. When Qiyana holds the river element, move outside the root range of Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal. If she disappears with the brush element, move into your team's vision.
Qiyana.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Qiyana P Royal Privilege, Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal, and Qiyana E Audacity. Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid building a large amount of health alone. If movement restricting crowd control stops your engage, consider Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar.
Qiyana.fight: Counterattack when Qiyana has used W Terrashape and E Audacity and remains in front of you. Shield with Ambessa W Repudiation just before her damage lands. While the slow from Ambessa E Lacerate is active, land the blade tip of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam. Give each ability a movement command to choose your direction in and out.
Qiyana.laning: Position toward open ground to avoid facing Qiyana near the river or walls.
Qiyana.combo: After Qiyana E Audacity is down, dash in with Ambessa E Lacerate and auto attack after the extra hit at the end of the dash. Land the blade tip of the first cast of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam to prepare the second, then finish with Ambessa Q Sundering Slam and an auto attack. When engaging with Ambessa R Public Execution, check that Qiyana is the farthest enemy champion along its line. After landing, follow with Ambessa E Lacerate, an auto attack, then Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam.
Qiyana.escape: Do not rush an engage when only Qiyana W Terrashape is down; she can escape with Qiyana E Audacity. Look for a chance to close in with Ambessa R Public Execution after both mobility abilities are down, especially before Qiyana E Audacity comes back. If you would land where the root from Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal or the stun from Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent can hit you, reposition first or Ambessa's dashes will be stopped after landing.
Qiyana.phase: Both champions are strong in the midgame. Avoid giving Qiyana an early or midgame lead, build armor, and look for moments when her mobility abilities are down. In the late game, stay with your team but away from terrain to limit angles for Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent.
Qiyana.teamfight: Approach from the flank after your team draws their attention, and check whether Qiyana's key crowd control and mobility abilities are down. If damage comes in just before you engage, absorb it with Ambessa W Repudiation. When using Ambessa R Public Execution, check that the farthest enemy champion along its line is your intended target. After taking out one target, use the dash from Ambessa E Lacerate in your planned direction to escape.

Ryze.watch: If Ryze E Spell Flux hits you, stay away from allies until the mark expires to avoid the amplified damage from Ryze Q Overload. Ryze W Rune Prison roots you after the mark is applied, so dodge Ryze E Spell Flux first.
Ryze.build: Ryze deals primarily magic damage, so build magic resistance first. If the root from Ryze W Rune Prison after Ryze E Spell Flux stops you from engaging, consider Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar.
Ryze.fight: When Ryze steps forward to last-hit, dash in with Ambessa E Lacerate. While he is slowed, land the blade tip of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep and hit him with Ambessa Q Sundering Slam, then back off. If Ryze E Spell Flux has hit you, watch for the follow-up root from Ryze W Rune Prison and do not stay close for long.
Ryze.combo: Use Ambessa E Lacerate with a movement command toward the enemy to dash in and land its additional hit. After an auto attack, hit the blade tip of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep. Use the readied Ambessa Q Sundering Slam, auto attack, then direct your dash backward to leave. When engaging with Ambessa R Public Execution, follow the landing with Ambessa E Lacerate → auto attack → Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep → Ambessa Q Sundering Slam.
Ryze.escape: After Ryze has used the Ryze E Spell Flux and Ryze W Rune Prison combo, you have an opening to engage with less risk of being rooted.
Ryze.phase: Pressure Ryze actively in the mid game as you complete core items. Late game, look for an isolated Ryze from the flank instead of engaging a grouped enemy team alone.
Ryze.teamfight: When your allies draw attention and Ryze's main crowd control is down, flank and use Ambessa R Public Execution to reach him. If damage is incoming just before you engage, use Ambessa W Repudiation for its shield. After the kill, dash out with Ambessa E Lacerate.

Talon.watch: Getting hit by both the outward and returning passes of Talon W Rake makes it easy for Talon to trigger Talon P Blade's End. If the first pass hits, use Ambessa P Drakehound's Step to leave the return path. If Talon R Shadow Assault is available, do not chase too far: he can escape under stealth or counterattack.
Talon.build: All of Talon's damage is physical, so get armor such as Cloth Armor early. Build health alongside armor to account for Talon's flat penetration. If the healing from Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy keeps you from securing a kill, buy Executioner's Calling early.
Talon.fight: Just before Talon uses an ability, use Ambessa W Repudiation to absorb the damage. Immediately after the slow from Ambessa E Lacerate, hit with the blade tip of Ambessa Q, then back off.
Talon.laning: Afterward, push the wave to keep Talon from roaming, ward the jungle routes, and share his location with your team.
Talon.combo: When Talon steps forward to last-hit, use Ambessa E Lacerate with a movement command to dash in and land its additional hit. Auto attack, then hit the blade tip of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep. Follow with Ambessa Q Sundering Slam and an auto attack. If you expect Talon to retaliate, absorb it with Ambessa W Repudiation.
Talon.escape: Right after Talon uses Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy is a chance to close the gap. Dodge the return path of Talon W Rake before engaging. If you confirm that Talon has already used Talon R Shadow Assault, you can close in and counterattack with Ambessa R Public Execution.
Talon.phase: Talon's impact falls off late game, so fight as a group. As Ambessa, avoid diving deep alone and look for an exposed enemy from the flank.
Talon.teamfight: If Talon dives your backline, stay with your allies and lock him down with the suppression and stun from Ambessa R Public Execution. When attacking, enter from the flank after your allies draw attention, and check that the enemy's main crowd control and defensive abilities are down. Before securing a kill, plan your escape route with Ambessa E Lacerate and Ambessa P Drakehound's Step.

Sylas.watch: The first dash of Sylas E Abscond / Abduct deals no damage, but the chain he throws afterward knocks you up and sets up his combo if it hits. When using Ambessa P Drakehound's Step to escape, choose your direction around the second chain rather than the first dash. The crossing point of Sylas Q Chain Lash explodes after a delay, so leave it immediately. Watch for the healing from Sylas W Kingslayer when Sylas is low on health.
Sylas.build: The healing from Sylas W Kingslayer may let him survive your combo, so buy Executioner's Calling early. Build magic resistance over armor against his main damage.
Sylas.fight: When Sylas steps forward to last hit, dash in with Ambessa E Lacerate and hit him with the blade tip of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep while he is slowed. Dodge the second chain of Sylas E Abscond / Abduct with a dash, and look for a kill when both Sylas W Kingslayer and Sylas E Abscond / Abduct are down. Rather than staying close, use your combo, then dash backward to disengage.
Sylas.laning: After pushing the wave, ward an entrance to the enemy jungle or move to a side lane.
Sylas.combo: Give Ambessa E Lacerate a movement command to dash in and land its additional hit at the end. Follow with an auto attack, the blade tip of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep, the readied Ambessa Q Sundering Slam, and another auto attack. If Sylas is about to use an ability, absorb the damage with Ambessa W Repudiation and use its shield and empowered slam.
Sylas.escape: Do not engage just because Sylas has used the first dash of Sylas E Abscond / Abduct; dodge the second chain first. If Sylas W Kingslayer is also down, he has fewer ways to escape when you close in with Ambessa R Public Execution. When you need to retreat during a fight, give a backward movement command while casting an Ambessa ability to direct your dash.
Sylas.phase: Ambessa peaks in the mid game as she completes core items. Late game, look for an isolated target from the flank instead of engaging a grouped enemy team alone.
Sylas.teamfight: Right after Sylas dives in with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, lock him down with Ambessa R Public Execution and kill him before he can heal with Sylas W Kingslayer. When entering from the flank, check that the enemy's main crowd control and defensive abilities are down, and account for Ambessa R Public Execution targeting the farthest enemy champion along its line. If damage is about to hit just before you engage, use Ambessa W Repudiation. After the kill, line up an escape route with Ambessa E Lacerate.

Syndra.watch: Syndra W Force of Will deals true damage, and Syndra R Unleashed Power executes targets at low health, so watch your health while fighting.
Syndra.build: Buy boots early for the movement speed to dodge the telegraphed locations of Syndra Q Dark Sphere, Syndra W Force of Will, and Syndra E Scatter the Weak. Build magic resistance against her main damage, and get health as well to account for the true damage from Syndra W Force of Will and the execute threshold of Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Syndra.fight: After Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down, use Ambessa E Lacerate with a movement command to close in when Syndra steps forward to last-hit.
Syndra.laning: After pushing the wave, ward an entrance to the enemy jungle or move to a side lane.
Syndra.combo: When Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down, give Ambessa E Lacerate a movement command toward her to dash in and land the additional hit, then auto attack. Hit the blade tip of the first cast of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam to ready the second hit, then recast it and auto attack. Use auto attacks between abilities to consume passive charges and restore resources. On your way out, give a backward movement command during an ability to direct your dash.
Syndra.escape: Syndra E Scatter the Weak is her self-defense tool, so immediately after it is spent is your opening to engage. If Syndra Q Dark Sphere lies between you and Syndra, leave the stun line first, then close the gap with Ambessa E Lacerate or Ambessa R Public Execution.
Syndra.phase: Late game, avoid engaging a grouped enemy team alone and look for an isolated Syndra from the flank.
Syndra.teamfight: Take a flank while your allies draw attention. Once Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down, engage with Ambessa R Public Execution. It sends you to the farthest enemy champion along its line, so check that Syndra is the last target on that line before casting. If burst damage is incoming just before you engage, absorb it with Ambessa W Repudiation. After killing Syndra, dash out with Ambessa E Lacerate along your planned route.

Veigar.watch: Veigar E Event Horizon stuns you when you cross its edge. If trapped inside, move within it and wait for it to disappear instead of trying to cross the edge with Ambessa P Drakehound's Step. Sidestep Veigar W Dark Matter when its ground indicator appears. If you are below half health, leave the range of Veigar R Primordial Burst, which grows stronger based on your missing health.
Veigar.build: Veigar deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance over armor. Prioritize movement speed to walk out of the marked area of Veigar W Dark Matter.
Veigar.fight: Just before Veigar uses a damaging ability, use Ambessa W Repudiation for a shield and stronger slam damage.
Veigar.laning: Early on, use the blade tip of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep to last hit and poke while keeping up in levels. Stand behind minions to avoid unnecessary hits from Veigar Q Baleful Strike, and pressure Veigar when he steps forward to last hit to hinder his stacks and farm. After pushing the wave, ward an enemy jungle entrance or join a side lane.
Veigar.combo: Once Veigar E Event Horizon is down, use Ambessa E Lacerate with a movement command to close in, then auto attack after the extra hit at the end of the dash. Hit with the blade tip of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep, then use the prepared Ambessa Q Sundering Slam and auto attack. If Veigar is far away, you can hit a minion with the first Q to prepare the second strike.
Veigar.escape: The moment Veigar E Event Horizon goes down is your chance to engage. Veigar has no ability to create distance himself, so close in and use Ambessa R Public Execution to chain its suppression and stun. While trapped inside the cage, avoid dashing across its edge. After the trade, use Ambessa P Drakehound's Step backward to disengage.
Veigar.phase: Veigar keeps gaining stacks late game, so look for an isolated target from the flank instead of engaging head-on alone.
Veigar.teamfight: Before an objective fight, check Veigar's position and whether Veigar E Event Horizon has been used. Once your allies draw the enemy's attention and key crowd control is down, flank Veigar with Ambessa R Public Execution. After landing, follow with Ambessa E Lacerate and Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep, and plan your escape route before securing the kill.

TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate W Pick a Card has locked in a gold card, stay outside auto attack range because one auto attack will stun you. Taking Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from behind minions can reduce its poke damage.
TwistedFate.build: Ambessa deals mostly physical damage and Twisted Fate has low armor, so prioritize bonus attack damage to increase your damage. If you need a defensive stat, build magic resistance against Twisted Fate's magic damage. Movement speed also helps you leave the marked attack area.
TwistedFate.fight: Right after Twisted Fate uses the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card is your chance to close in. When he steps forward to last hit, dash in and slow him with Ambessa E Lacerate, hit with the blade tip of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam, then disengage. Just before Twisted Fate's attack lands, use Ambessa W Repudiation for a shield.
TwistedFate.laning: Keep Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards in mind and stand behind minions. Save Ambessa E Lacerate for a trade.
TwistedFate.combo: Use Ambessa E Lacerate with a movement command toward Twisted Fate to dash in and land the extra hit, then auto attack. Hit the first strike of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep with the blade tip, then land the prepared second strike, Ambessa Q Sundering Slam, and an auto attack. When opening with Ambessa R Public Execution, make sure Twisted Fate is the farthest champion along its line. After landing, follow with Ambessa E Lacerate, an auto attack, Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep, and Ambessa Q Sundering Slam.
TwistedFate.escape: While Twisted Fate still has a gold card available through Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, stay out of auto attack range. Close in with Ambessa E Lacerate once the card is used or when he has a blue or red card.
TwistedFate.phase: In the mid game, look actively for opportunities as you gain bonus attack damage, but watch for roams with Twisted Fate R Destiny. Late game, do not engage grouped enemies alone.
TwistedFate.teamfight: Flank when Twisted Fate has used the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and your allies draw the enemy's attention. Make sure Twisted Fate is the farthest champion along the line of Ambessa R Public Execution, then close in and fit Ambessa E Lacerate, Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep, and Ambessa Q Sundering Slam between its suppression and stun. If you see Twisted Fate start the teleport from Twisted Fate R Destiny and he is in range, you can interrupt it with Ambessa R Public Execution. Before engaging, also plan a route out with Ambessa E Lacerate.

Viktor.watch: Viktor E Hextech Ray pokes in a line while hitting the wave, so avoid standing in line with your minions and dodge sideways. When Viktor W Gravity Field appears, immediately dash out with Ambessa P Drakehound's Step to avoid the stun. Do not keep trading inside it.
Viktor.build: Get movement speed first to make it easier to leave Viktor W Gravity Field. Build magic resistance against Viktor's damage.
Viktor.fight: When Viktor steps forward to last hit, close in with Ambessa E Lacerate for a short trade, then disengage. If Viktor W Gravity Field is down or you are outside its area, engage with Ambessa R Public Execution to chain its suppression and stun.
Viktor.combo: Use Ambessa E Lacerate with a movement command toward Viktor to land the extra hit and slow at the end of the dash, then auto attack. Hit the first strike of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep with the blade tip, follow with the prepared Ambessa Q Sundering Slam and an auto attack, then dash out with Ambessa P Drakehound's Step.
Viktor.escape: When Viktor W Gravity Field appears, do not stay inside it. Dash out immediately with Ambessa P Drakehound's Step. Wait until Viktor W Gravity Field is down before going back in.
Viktor.phase: Late game, do not engage grouped enemies alone. Flank an isolated Viktor.
