Viktor.teamfight: After your allies draw attention, check whether Viktor W Gravity Field and his key defenses are down, then approach Viktor from the flank with Ambessa R Public Execution. If damage is incoming just before you engage, use Ambessa W Repudiation for a shield. After securing a kill, dash out along your planned route with Ambessa E Lacerate.

Vex.watch: If the Doom indicator from Vex P Doom 'n Gloom is active, delay your engage: Vex can interrupt Ambessa's dash with a basic ability and inflict fear. If dashing applies a Gloom mark to you, move outside Vex's auto attack range and wait for the mark to disappear. If Vex R Shadow Surge hits you, move toward your allies so you can respond to Vex's dash together.
Vex.build: Prioritize magic resistance over armor against Vex's damage. Also consider movement speed to walk out of Vex's marked areas and tenacity for situations where your dashes are restricted. Ambessa's physical damage is effective against Vex's low armor.
Vex.fight: Look for the moment Vex has spent the Doom effect from Vex P Doom 'n Gloom on the wave or poke and Vex W Personal Space is also down. When Vex steps forward to last hit, close in with Ambessa E Lacerate for a short trade. Use a movement command with each ability to choose your direction of entry and exit.
Vex.laning: After pushing the wave, ward an enemy jungle entrance or move to a side lane.
Vex.combo: Once Vex's Doom effect is down, use Ambessa E Lacerate with a movement command to close in, then auto attack after the extra hit at the end of the dash. Hit with the blade tip of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep to prepare Ambessa Q Sundering Slam, then use it and auto attack. If Vex is very close, dash sideways or backward to create enough space to hit with the edge of Q.
Vex.escape: Engage after the fear from Vex P Doom 'n Gloom has been used and the shield from Vex W Personal Space is down. If Vex's Doom indicator is active again, delay your dash.
Vex.phase: Late game, look for an isolated Vex from the flank instead of engaging grouped enemies alone.
Vex.teamfight: Check that Vex's key crowd control and Vex W Personal Space are down. After your allies draw attention, flank Vex with Ambessa R Public Execution. If damage is incoming just before you engage, use Ambessa W Repudiation for a shield and a stronger slam. First move a marked, low health ally out of range to prevent another cast of Vex R Shadow Surge. After engaging, keep an escape route open with Ambessa E Lacerate.

Vladimir.watch: When Vladimir charges Vladimir E Tides of Blood, put minions between you or move out of range. Vladimir W Sanguine Pool can dodge key abilities, so do not use Ambessa R Public Execution until the pool ends. Vladimir R Hemoplague increases the damage you take while infected; re-engage after it ends.
Vladimir.build: Build magic resistance first against Vladimir's damage. Buy Executioner's Calling early to reduce the healing from Vladimir Q Transfusion, Vladimir W Sanguine Pool, and Vladimir R Hemoplague. Blade of The Ruined King is also effective against a Vladimir who has stacked health because it deals damage based on maximum health.
Vladimir.fight: Use Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep or Ambessa E Lacerate to draw out Vladimir W Sanguine Pool first. Once the pool ends, catch him with Ambessa R Public Execution and weave basic attacks between abilities for a short burst. While Vladimir charges Vladimir E Tides of Blood, you can use his slowed movement to close the gap.
Vladimir.combo: After Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is down, engage with Ambessa R Public Execution, then use Ambessa E Lacerate, a basic attack, Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep, and Ambessa Q Sundering Slam in that order. Land Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep first to ready its second strike, and hit Q with the blade tip. Spend Ambessa P Drakehound's Step charges on basic attacks between abilities.
Vladimir.escape: The moment Vladimir W Sanguine Pool ends is your chance to engage with Ambessa R Public Execution. If Vladimir is charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood, close in while his movement is slowed, and use the shield from Ambessa W Repudiation when you are about to take damage.
Vladimir.phase: Ambessa is strong in the mid game as she completes core items. In the late game, target isolated enemies from the flank instead of diving a grouped team alone.
Vladimir.teamfight: Do not group up and let Vladimir R Hemoplague hit several allies. If infected, engage after its effect ends. While your allies draw attention, check from the flank that Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is down, then catch a priority target with Ambessa R Public Execution. Before engaging, plan an exit path using the dash from Ambessa E Lacerate.

Xerath.watch: Watch for the slow from Xerath W Eye of Destruction and the stun from Xerath E Shocking Orb. In particular, avoid getting stunned and hit by follow-up abilities. Start dodging immediately when you see Xerath cast Xerath R Rite of the Arcane.
Xerath.build: First, get a way to remove or break the stun from Xerath E Shocking Orb. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Xerath's damage, and consider movement speed to help escape his telegraphed areas.
Xerath.fight: Dodge sideways and close the gap while Xerath charges Xerath Q Arcanopulse. Engage after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down. When Xerath steps forward to last-hit, close in with Ambessa E Lacerate, deal a short burst of damage, and leave. Xerath has no mobility ability, so once you close the gap, you can catch him with Ambessa R Public Execution.
Xerath.laning: Farm while avoiding heavy damage and wait for Xerath to run out of mana. Then push the wave and call your jungler, or establish vision and move to a side lane.
Xerath.combo: Once Xerath E Shocking Orb is down, use Ambessa E Lacerate with a movement command toward Xerath to dash in, then basic attack after the additional strike. Next, hit with the blade tip of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep, use Ambessa Q Sundering Slam, and basic attack. If you engage with Ambessa R Public Execution, follow your landing with Ambessa E Lacerate, a basic attack, Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep, and Ambessa Q Sundering Slam in that order.
Xerath.escape: Xerath has no mobility ability, so the window to engage opens immediately after the stun from Xerath E Shocking Orb and the slow from Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down. You can also approach while dodging sideways as he charges Xerath Q Arcanopulse. After a short trade, enter a backward movement command during Ambessa's next ability to dash out.
Xerath.phase: Ambessa peaks in the mid game as she completes core items. In the late game, target an isolated Xerath from the flank instead of diving a grouped team alone.
Xerath.teamfight: After your allies draw attention, engage from the flank once key crowd control such as Xerath E Shocking Orb is down. Before using Ambessa R Public Execution, check which enemy champion is farthest along your chosen line so you can target Xerath. If Xerath's damage is incoming just before you engage, shield yourself with Ambessa W Repudiation. Plan your escape route with Ambessa E Lacerate in advance so you can leave after killing Xerath.

Zed.watch: Watch the position of Zed W Living Shadow and move outside the slow radius of Zed E Shadow Slash cast from it. When Zed engages with Zed R Death Mark, he will try to stack damage while the mark is active. Look for a chance to interrupt his combo with the suppression and stun from Ambessa R Public Execution.
Zed.build: Build armor early against the main damage from Zed Q Razor Shuriken, Zed E Shadow Slash, and Zed R Death Mark. Zed P Contempt for the Weak deals magic damage based on maximum health, so do not rely solely on stacking health.
Zed.fight: Close in just after Zed uses Zed W Living Shadow, once the shadow has disappeared or Zed has already swapped positions. Slow him with Ambessa E Lacerate, hit with the blade's edge of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep, and weave basic attacks between abilities for a short trade.
Zed.combo: When Zed's mobility is down, dash in with Ambessa E Lacerate and basic attack after the additional strike at the end of the dash. Then hit with the blade's edge of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep to ready Ambessa Q Sundering Slam, use it, and basic attack.
Zed.escape: Do not engage just because Zed W Living Shadow is down; check whether he can still escape with Zed R Death Mark. In particular, look for a chance to catch him with Ambessa R Public Execution before Zed R Death Mark comes back up. Also stay outside the range of the slow from Zed E Shadow Slash cast from his shadow.
Zed.phase: Both champions are strong in the mid game, so do not give Zed an early lead, and look for openings when his mobility is down. In the late game, Zed weakens and has fewer isolated targets when your team groups up, but Ambessa should also avoid diving a grouped enemy team alone.
Zed.teamfight: After your allies draw the enemy's attention, engage from the flank with Ambessa R Public Execution when the enemy's key crowd control and defensive abilities are down. It sends you to the farthest enemy champion along its line, so check your target. If Zed engages on you or an ally, look for a chance to interrupt his combo with its suppression and stun. Use the shield from Ambessa W Repudiation just before burst damage lands, and plan an exit path with Ambessa E Lacerate before engaging.

Yone.watch: If Yone repeatedly hits minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel, his dash and knockup are ready, so keep your distance until the stacks expire. After he engages with Yone E Soul Unbound, its return can deal additional damage; back away in advance if your health is low. Yone R Fate Sealed pulls enemies it hits together and moves him behind the last champion, so check that you are not at the very back of your team in a fight.
Yone.build: The provided information is insufficient to choose a first purchase. Yone Q Mortal Steel and Yone P Way of the Hunter deal different types of damage, so do not focus on only one type of resistance. Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on maximum health, so be careful about stacking only health.
Yone.fight: Do not engage first when the gust from Yone Q Mortal Steel is ready. When Yone steps forward to last-hit or his gust stacks expire, dash in with Ambessa E Lacerate and hit with the blade tip of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep while he is slowed. Just before Yone uses an ability, shield yourself with Ambessa W Repudiation and absorb damage to increase its slam damage.
Yone.laning: Use the blade's edge of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep to last-hit and harass at the same time. If Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions to prepare his gust, keep your distance.
Yone.combo: When the gust from Yone Q Mortal Steel is not ready, use Ambessa E Lacerate with a movement command to close in and land its additional strike. Then use a basic attack, hit with the blade tip of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep, use Ambessa Q Sundering Slam, and basic attack. Spend passive charges with basic attacks between abilities, then enter a backward movement command while casting an ability to get out at the end.
Yone.escape: Look to engage after the gust from Yone Q Mortal Steel expires and Yone E Soul Unbound or Yone R Fate Sealed is down. Yone can chain multiple mobility abilities to escape, so do not dive deep as soon as he uses one. If Yone engages with Yone E Soul Unbound, look for a chance to stop his return with the suppression and stun from Ambessa R Public Execution.
Yone.phase: In the late game, do not dive a grouped enemy team alone. Target an isolated enemy from the flank.
Yone.teamfight: Space out from your allies so Yone W Spirit Cleave does not hit several of you and give him a larger shield. After your allies draw the enemy's attention, confirm that Yone's key mobility and crowd control are down, then engage from the flank with Ambessa R Public Execution. If you expect burst damage just before engaging, absorb it with Ambessa W Repudiation. After catching your target, dash out with Ambessa E Lacerate.

Zoe.watch: If Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble hits, it puts you to sleep shortly afterward, making Zoe Q Paddle Star! easier to land. Dodge the incoming bubble with an Ambessa P Drakehound's Step dash. If it hits, move behind a wall or an ally before the sleep takes effect to get out of Zoe Q Paddle Star!'s path. A missed bubble remains as a trap, so watch narrow paths without vision and brush entrances.
Zoe.build: Prioritize movement speed to get out of the area targeted by Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. Magic resistance matters more than armor against Zoe's main damage, but build health too, accounting for the bubble's resistance reduction and true damage.
Zoe.fight: Right after Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down, dash onto Zoe with Ambessa E Lacerate when she steps forward to last-hit. While she is slowed by Ambessa E Lacerate, land Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep with the blade's edge, follow with Ambessa Q Sundering Slam, then back off. If you see Zoe wind up Zoe Q Paddle Star! and have an angle for Ambessa R Public Execution, its stun can stop her from redirecting it.
Zoe.laning: After pushing the wave, establish vision at the enemy jungle entrance or join a side lane.
Zoe.combo: When Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down, use Ambessa E Lacerate with a move command toward Zoe to dash in, then land the additional hit as the dash ends. Follow with a basic attack, Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep at the blade's edge, Ambessa Q Sundering Slam, and another basic attack. Use basic attacks between abilities to consume Ambessa P Drakehound's Step charges and recover resources.
Zoe.escape: Right after Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down is your chance to engage. If Zoe has used Zoe R Portal Jump, target the starting point she will return to.
Zoe.phase: Later in the game, look for an isolated Zoe from the flank instead of engaging the grouped enemy team alone.
Zoe.teamfight: After an ally draws attention, approach Zoe from the side with Ambessa R Public Execution while Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down. Before using it, check that Zoe is the farthest enemy champion along its line; after landing, chain Ambessa E Lacerate, a basic attack, Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep, and Ambessa Q Sundering Slam. If Zoe’s burst is incoming just before you engage, absorb it with Ambessa W Repudiation. Plan in advance where to escape using the dash from Ambessa E Lacerate after the kill.

Yasuo.watch: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has a narrow hitbox, so step sideways out of its line as he approaches. Once he lands two Qs and has his tornado ready, prepare for the knockup and delay your engage, since he can follow with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Yasuo.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath. Armor does not block the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Slowing his attack speed also slows how often he can use Yasuo Q Steel Tempest.
Yasuo.fight: Remove the shield from Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer with light poke before committing to a trade. After dodging Yasuo Q Steel Tempest's tornado or just after he fires it, close in with Ambessa E Lacerate and hit with the blade tip of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam while he is slowed. Use Ambessa W Repudiation as Yasuo attacks to absorb the damage and empower its slam.
Yasuo.laning: Keep the wave thin on your side to give Yasuo fewer minions to dash through with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.combo: Use Ambessa E Lacerate with a movement command to close in, then basic attack after the extra hit at the end of the dash. Land the first hit of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Ambessa Q Sundering Slam at the blade tip to set up the second hit, then basic attack after Ambessa Q Sundering Slam. Remove the shield from Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer with light poke before this combo.
Yasuo.escape: The moment Yasuo fires the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest is an opening to engage. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade comes back quickly, so do not chase just because he used it once. Look for a chance to lock him down with the suppression and stun from Ambessa R Public Execution before Yasuo R Last Breath is ready again.
Yasuo.phase: Late in the game, avoid diving a grouped enemy team alone. Flank and target someone separated from the group.
Yasuo.teamfight: Enter from the flank after your allies draw attention, and check that the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and his main defensive tools are down. Ambessa R Public Execution travels to the farthest enemy champion along the chosen line, so check who is behind your target before casting. If you expect heavy damage just before engaging, use Ambessa W Repudiation. After securing the target, escape with the dash from Ambessa E Lacerate.
